people.name: Ananiah
people.line: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem

people.name: Azariah
people.line: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Israelite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Hasshub
people.line: A repairer of Jerusalem's wall opposite his house.

people.name: Maaseiah

translations.web: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.
translations.bsb: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house, and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.
translations.kjv: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
translations.asv: After them repaired Benjamin and Hasshub over against their house. After them repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah beside his own house.
